1.w: Give thanks to YHWH, for [He is] good, for His loving devotion [is] forever!

2.w: Now let Israel say that His loving devotion [is] forever!

3.w: Now let the house of Aaron say that His loving devotion [is] forever!

4.w: Now let those fearing YHWH say that His loving devotion [is] forever!

5.w: In distress I called on YAH; YAH answered me in a broad place.

6.w: YHWH [is] with me; I will not fear—what can man do to me?

7.w: YHWH [is] with me as the One helping me; and I shall look on those hating me.

8.w: [It is] better to take refuge in YHWH, than to trust in man.

9.w: [It is] better to take refuge in YHWH, than to trust in princes.

10.w: All nations surrounded me; in the name of YHWH I surely cut them off.

11.w: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me, and in the name of YHWH I surely cut them off!

12.w: They have surrounded me like bees, they have been extinguished as fire among thorns; and in the name of YHWH I surely cut them off!

13.w: You have severely thrust me that I might fall, and YHWH helped me.

14.w: My strength and song [is] YAH; and He has become to me salvation.

15.w: The voice of rejoicing and salvation [is] in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of YHWH acts with strength.

16.w: The right hand of YHWH is exalted; the right hand of YHWH acts with strength.”

17.w: I will not die, but I will live, that I might recount the works of YAH.

18.w: Yah, chastened me severely, and to death He has not given me up.

19.w: Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will enter into them; I will give thanks to YAH.

20.w: This [is] the gate of YHWH; the righteous shall enter into it.

21.w: I thank You, for You have answered me, and You have become to me for salvation.

22.w: The stone the builders rejected has become as the head of the corner.

23.w: From YHWH this is; it is marvelous in our eyes.

24.w: This [is] the day YHWH has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

25.w: I ask, O YHWH, save [us] now. I ask, O YHWH, send prosperity now!

26.w: Blessed [is] the one coming in the name of YHWH; we bless you⁺ from the house of YHWH.

27.w: YHWH [is] God, and He has given light to us! Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar!

28.w: You [are] my God, and I will give You thanks; my God, I will exalt You!

29.w: Give thanks to YHWH, for [He is] good; for His loving devotion [is] forever!
